questions.question: What should success look like for future hammer-head generation?
questions.assumed: A coherent fitted assembly whose load path reads without explanation

questions.question: Who should benefit from the improvement?
questions.assumed: Both connected agents and local generator scripts

questions.question: Should this be a whole-hammer generator or a reusable middle-grain head operation?
questions.assumed: Reusable add_impact_head operation

questions.question: Which first impact family should be guaranteed?
questions.assumed: Symmetrical dual-strike industrial hammer/maul

questions.question: Should decorative claws and floating status fins remain in the semantic head?
questions.assumed: No; every generated part needs a structural or protective role

questions.question: At what build phase should agents call the operation?
questions.assumed: REFINE

questions.question: Should scripts import the constructor directly?
questions.assumed: Yes, through ops.__init__

questions.question: How should the top armor be composed?
questions.assumed: One inset fitted cap with a consistent reveal

questions.question: How should side armor be composed?
questions.assumed: Front and rear cheek plates derived from the body profile

questions.question: How should each striking face connect to the body?
questions.assumed: Socketed shoulder, load collar, strike face, and outer rim

questions.question: How should the handle meet the head?
questions.assumed: A dedicated underside socket and collar centered on the body

questions.question: What happens when dimensions cannot physically nest?
questions.assumed: Reject atomically before creating geometry

questions.question: Should the tool silently resize a plate or face to fit?
questions.assumed: No; report the offending dimensions

questions.question: What should happen when a fitted joint later opens?
questions.assumed: Persist an acceptance failure that blocks phase promotion

questions.question: Should all visible proportions be explicit?
questions.assumed: Yes; no hidden dimension table

questions.question: Which parts should remain separately addressable?
questions.assumed: Body, three armor plates, two shoulders, two collars, two faces, two rims, and handle socket/collar

questions.question: Should material assignment be built into the operation?
questions.assumed: No; deterministic part ids support later material assignment

questions.question: Which armor joints require zero-gap verification?
questions.assumed: Top/body and both cheek/body contacts

questions.question: Which structural joints require zero-gap verification?
questions.assumed: Both shoulders/body, both collars/faces, and handle socket/body

questions.question: How should intentional socket overlap be classified?
questions.assumed: Explicit JoineryIntent with supplied insertion depth

questions.question: Should add_primitive or existing scene replay change?
questions.assumed: No; the feature is additive

questions.question: Should the app integration suite pin reachability?
questions.assumed: Yes, explicitly include add_impact_head

questions.question: How should the reported hammer be repaired?
questions.assumed: Replace its manual head block with the semantic operation and remove incoherent decorations

questions.question: What evidence is required beyond unit tests?
questions.assumed: Regenerate BLEND, GLB, and PNG in real Blender and visually inspect the render

questions.question: How should a broad striking face avoid reading as a blank disk?
questions.assumed: Use a smaller replaceable wear insert socketed inside the retaining rim
